item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 22/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will move across the coast of southern China at night on the second day of the Lunar New Year. Under the influence of the associated intense northeast monsoon, it will become cold appreciably and windy over the region on the third and fourth days of the Lunar New Year. A dry replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week. The weather will improve and become cold again over the region.

Date/Month: 23/01 (Monday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4, north force 5 at night.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Sunny intervals during the day. One or two light rain patches and mist in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 18 - 22 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
